title: Understanding and Evaluating Trust in Generative AI and Large Language Models for Spreadsheets

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure a specific bias, but rather proposes a theoretical trustworthiness framework. It evaluates the concept of bias conceptually, recommending that developers use external bias evaluation tools (such as IBM's AI Fairness 360) and establish regular bias audits to detect conscious and subconscious biases (e.g., misogyny or racism) in LLM-generated spreadsheet formulas.
